desc:
GIANT VS ALL!!

1 Player is picked as the Giant and put into a fully destructible map! 
Take out 10 Humans before the time runs out and win the game!


10 Players are picked as Humans... Hide and Outrun the Giant as you complete minigames to lower the total Round time!

UNLOCK GIANTS WITH POINTS YOU EARN FROM SURVIVING!!
